request.spec:
When a grade has no rate in force on a date on a sheet nor on its parents, a sheet that was
cloned uses the rate of the sheet it was cloned from (and so on up that sheet's parents and
source).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
When a grade has no rate in force on a date on a sheet nor on its parents, a sheet that was
cloned uses the rate of the sheet it was cloned from (and so on up that sheet's parents and
source).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A cloned sheet now falls back to the rates of the sheet it was cloned from. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests: the clone-source test and the 3 other scenarios in the spec.

**How a grade's rate is found now:**
1. The sheet's own rates.
2. Its parent, then the parent's parent, up to 3 levels (unchanged).
3. If the sheet was cloned, the source sheet, checked the same way: its own rates, its parents, then its own source, and so on.

Each sheet is checked only once, so a loop of links can't repeat. The source's rates are read live, so a rate set on the source after cloning reaches the clone wherever the clone has none of its own.

**Changes:**
- **Stored data:** new migration `V101__sheet_cloned_from.sql` adds a `cloned_from` column to `sheet`. `SheetCloner` fills it with the source id when cloning. Sheets cloned before this change have no source recorded, so they won't get the fallback.
- **Server:** `RateRepository` now has a `lineage` helper that gives the order above, and `findAll` uses it. Everything that works out dues or rates goes through `findAll`, so they all pick up the fallback. The as-of snapshots (`AsOfSchemas.lineage`) use the same helper, so a snapshot also copies the source's rates.
- **Front end:** comments in `features/rates/rates.ts` only. It already applies rates in the order the server sends them.

One behaviour to know about: the sheet's parent and source links are now read from the live sheet table, even when viewing a sheet as of an earlier date. These links aren't stored by date anyway. As a side effect, a snapshot now follows the parent chain past the first level; before, it stopped there.

Only the sheet's own source is followed. If a parent was itself cloned, the parent's source is not checked. The request names only the cloned sheet's own source, and no test covers the parent case.
